outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Pregnant women with HELLP syndrome who delivered at a tertiary care center in Kathmandu between April 13, 2016 and April 12, 2020.
finding: The prevalence of HELLP syndrome was 0.23%, with high rates of maternal (9.1%) and perinatal (45.45%) mortality, preterm birth (68.18%), and admission to high dependency/neonatal intensive care units.
mod_finding: Of the 44 women with HELLP, 27 (61.36%) delivered via cesarean section.
